title: PaginatedQueryShapes
description: Paginated collection of query shapes. This endpoint returns a maximum of 100 results.

links.description: List of one or more Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) that point to API sub-resources, related API resources, or both. RFC 5988 outlines these relationships.

results.description: List of returned documents that MongoDB Cloud provides when completing this request.

totalCount.description: Total number of documents available. MongoDB Cloud omits this value if `includeCount` is set to `false`. The total number is an estimate and may not be exact.

href.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that points another API resource to which this response has some relationship. This URL often begins with `https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas`.

rel.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that defines the semantic relationship between this resource and another API resource. This URL often begins with `https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas`.

QueryShapeResponse.description: Response containing the details and status of a query shape. The query shape field may be null if the user lacks PII view access.

command.description: The MongoDB command type issued for a query shape.

namespace.description: Human-readable label that identifies the namespace on the specified host. The resource expresses this parameter value as `<database>.<collection>`.

queryShape.description: A query shape is a set of specifications that group similar queries together. Specifications can include filters, sorts, projections, aggregation pipeline stages, a namespace, and others. Queries that have similar specifications have the same query shape. This field may be null if the user lacks PII view access.

queryShapeHash.description: A hexadecimal string that represents the hash of a MongoDB query shape.

status.description: The rejection status of a query shape. Use REJECTED to prevent the query shape from executing on the cluster, or UNREJECTED to allow it to execute.
